description: Defines the HistoryModalController class which manages the history modal UI component, including opening, closing, and handling associated notes and events within the web application.

classes.name: HistoryModalController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the note history modal, including note assignment and modal visibility.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, resetting state and calling parent cleanup.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with dependencies, sets up observable properties, and adds command handler.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the current note being viewed or edited in the modal.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Opens the modal with the specified note.

methods.name: dismissModal
methods.description: Closes the modal by clearing the current note.
